dedupe_keys.name: dataset for article a robust active power control algorithm to maximize wind farm power tracking margins in waked conditions

description: Tamaro, Simone and colleagues describe this resource in the native deposit. The reproducibility collection provides simulation results for layouts with 75 percent and 50 percent rotor overlap, labelled 3deg and 7deg. Figure scripts and data files accompany a separate C++ archive implementing four active-power controllers. This record covers the comparison data; the documented controller has a linked model record with its code role explicit. Exact case duration and complete raw-flow availability are not inferred from figure-reproduction files. Archives and script bodies were not opened. Zenodo provides the deposit with open access under cc-by-4.0. The native file inventory establishes deposited data, but values and linked file bodies were not read. Coverage is limited to the stated experiment, model or application; transfer to other turbines, sites or operating regimes requires separate assessment. Publication date alone does not establish current maintenance.
